slides.narration: Chapter 20: Neutrino Masses. Neutrinos are nearly massless — a million times lighter than the electron. The tower explains this through the seesaw mechanism: the heavier one partner is, the lighter the other must be.

The framework predicts the total mass of all three neutrinos: about 60 millielectronvolts. This is within reach of upcoming experiments. If confirmed, it would be a decisive test of the framework — a prediction with no adjustable parameters.
